title: Pure Rose Dragon
summary: Rose Dragon and Rose Plant cards built around Black Rose Dragon and its 2025 support wave, with generic staples. Black Rose Garden turns every monster on the field into a Plant, fueling Plant-specific Synchros and burn damage whenever Black Rose Dragon wipes the board.

summary.title: Starters
points: Roxrose Dragon searches any card that mentions Black Rose Dragon on Normal or Special Summon, including Black Rose Garden, Basal Rose Shoot, or White Rose Dragon.
Black Rose Garden adds a Rose Dragon monster from your Deck or GY to your hand on activation and turns all face-up monsters on the field into Plant monsters.
White Rose Dragon Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Dragon or Plant Tuner, and summons a Rose Dragon from your hand or GY on Normal Summon.
Red Rose Dragon Special Summons a Rose Dragon from the Deck and searches Basal Rose Shoot or Frozen Rose when used as Synchro Material for Black Rose Dragon or a Plant Synchro.

summary.title: Opening: Roxrose Dragon or White Rose Dragon + Red Rose Dragon
steps: Normal Summon Roxrose Dragon to search Black Rose Garden, activate Black Rose Garden to search White Rose Dragon, and Special Summon White Rose Dragon alongside Roxrose Dragon.
Synchro Summon Level 6 Rage Rose Witch or Level 7 Bramble Rose Dragon (using Twilight Rose Black Knight or Red Rose Dragon as the Plant Tuner once Black Rose Garden makes all monsters Plants).
Use Red Rose Dragon's Synchro trigger to Special Summon Roxrose Dragon or Blue Rose Dragon from the Deck and search Basal Rose Shoot or Frozen Rose.

summary.title: Black Rose Garden & Twilight Rose Black Knight
summary.text: Twilight Rose Black Knight revives Black Rose Dragon or a Level 4 or lower Plant on Normal or Special Summon and shifts a Plant's Level by 1 while you control a Synchro Monster. Because Black Rose Garden turns all monsters on the field into Plants, any Tuner becomes a Plant Tuner for Bramble Rose Dragon, and when Black Rose Dragon destroys Black Rose Garden, Garden inflicts 100 damage for each Plant in your GY and banishment—or 2400 damage if destroyed by Black Rose Dragon's effect.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Bramble Rose Dragon makes every monster effect the opponent activates cost 600 LP and shrink all monsters they control by 600 ATK, and Tributes itself as a Quick Effect on either turn to Special Summon Black Rose Dragon from the Extra Deck (treated as a Synchro Summon) for an instant board wipe.
Rage Rose Witch protects all Plant monsters you control from being destroyed by card effects—letting your board survive Black Rose Dragon's wipe—while milling Plants from the Deck and Extra Deck.
Ruddy Rose Dragon banishes all cards from both GYs on Synchro Summon, wipes the field if made with Black Rose Dragon or a Plant Synchro, and tributes itself to negate destruction effects.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Basal Rose Shoot Special Summons a Rose Dragon from the hand or GY in Defense Position and revives Black Rose Dragon or a Rose Dragon if destroyed while Set.
Frozen Rose sends a face-up monster you control to the GY to draw 2 cards and discard 1 (if you sent a Plant) or search a Level 4 or lower Plant in the End Phase.
Blooming of the Darkest Rose summons Rose Tokens and banishes itself from the GY to protect Black Rose Dragon from destruction.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Crossrose Dragon requires two monsters with different Types, which Black Rose Garden's Type-changing effect prevents, so it is omitted along with the page's generic Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon package.
